label: VERIFIED
extraction: OpenCode Plugin Architecture: TypeScript/JavaScript modules exporting functions receiving context object, returning hooks object. Hook events: tool.execute.before, tool.execute.after, etc. npm plugins auto-installed via Bun at startup, cached in ~/.cache/opencode/node_modules/. Local plugins loaded directly. Load order: npm plugins then local plugins. Dependencies via .opencode/package.json, Bun installs at startup. Plugins enable custom tools, external service integration, behavior modification. Community plugins available.
